metadataPath.description: Path to the generated metadata JSON file.

sourceFile.description: Path to the source domain model markdown file that was parsed.

metadata.description: Parsed metadata object containing entities, relationships, enums, and summary statistics.

statistics.description: Summary counts for entities, relationships, enums, and attributes in the emitted metadata.

appliedEntityFilter.description: Comma-separated entity filter applied to the output. Empty or omitted when the full model is emitted.
